detail.longDescription: OpenAI is building AI agents for everything from software engineers to everyday users, according to reports. The frontier lab is pushing to bring AI agents from niche developer tools to mainstream adoption. The move signals a major shift in how AI will be used, potentially automating complex multi-step tasks previously requiring human intervention. https:// techcrunch.com/2026/08/24/open ai-is-building-an-ai-agent-for-everything-will-everyone-use-them/ # AIagent # AI # GenAI # AgenticAI
